description: Angular component for device data input, managing form state, validation, and data binding for device configuration and transport configuration.

classes.name: DeviceDataComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for device data form, handling form initialization, validation, and data propagation.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form model.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback, not implemented.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription with cleanup.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided device data and updates display flags.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Returns validation errors if form is invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the bound model with form data if valid.
